population.normsAbout: Di usual range of each measurement for one age and sex.
population.cohortAbout: Readings of everybody wey agree make dem use am for research or public health. Differential privacy dey add calibrated noise and e dey use your privacy budget. k-anonymity (hide person inside group) dey hide every group wey small pass k.

system.title: How ATRA dey work
system.about: ATRA Health dey pair two digital twins for every person. Agents dey prepare di clinical work inside each twin, and clinicians wey we know dia names dey make every decision.

ahdt.name: Agentic Human Digital Twin
ahdt.about: E dey for life. E carry di person body data, models and context through 17 member twins, from di heart go reach social life. E dey exist whether di person dey sick or e no dey sick.

apdt.name: Agentic Patient Digital Twin
apdt.about: Dem dey open am when one care episode start for facility and dem dey close am when e end. E carry di history, examination, tests, diagnoses, prescriptions and decisions of dat episode.

system.workflowAbout: Wetin dey happen to one patient, step by step.

open.title: Clinician open one episode
open.about: Medical officer, nurse or community health worker go choose di patient and di reason for di visit.

intake.title: Dem record di intake
intake.about: Symptoms, examination findings, measurements and test results go turn FHIR records of di episode.

reason.title: Di reasoner propose
reason.about: E dey rank di differential diagnosis, choose tests by value and price, check treatments for safety and simulate dem for di patient twin. Every proposal get one explanation bundle with im evidence and sources.

agents.title: Agents prepare each decision
agents.about: Di diagnosis, treatment and care orchestrators dey gather evidence from di human twin and dem dey stop for each decision point.

decide.title: Di medical officer decide
decide.about: Accept, edit or reject di diagnosis. Sign di prescription. Dem no fit sign prescription wey get blocking safety issue until dem change am.

verify.title: Di pharmacist verify
verify.about: Di signed prescription go reach di pharmacist worklist for di same run, to verify, query or reject.

explain.title: Di patient see explanation
explain.about: Each result for simple words for di patient own language, with consent and preference controls.

twin.title: Di human twin keep dey learn
twin.about: Readings from devices and from di facility dey update di member twins, and dia agents dey watch dia standing goals.

system.layersAbout: Di lower layers dey support di higher ones.

1.name: Physical
1.about: Di person, dia devices and actuators, and di clinicians wey dey enter data.

2.name: Network and cloud integration
2.about: Di edge service for each facility or home, device transports and store-and-forward.

3.name: Data ingestion
3.about: Validation, unit harmonisation, pseudonymisation, di data stores and di knowledge graphs.

4.name: Model
4.about: Mechanistic body models, trained machine-learning models, and language and speech models.

5.name: Explainable AI
5.about: One explainer for every model output.

6.name: Service
6.about: Data, models and simulation, explanations, cognitive services and di connections between twins.

7.name: Agentic
7.about: Worker agents, orchestrators, di conductor and di external API.

8.name: Application
8.about: Dis web app, di mobile apps, SMS, USSD and voice.

system.ahdtAgentsAbout: Workers dey do one job, one orchestrator dey run each member twin, and di conductor dey coordinate dem.
system.apdtAgentsAbout: Dem dey prepare di clinical work. Every decision stay with one clinician wey we know im name.

monitoring.name: Monitoring
monitoring.about: E dey read di twin state and when dem last observe each field.

anomaly.name: Anomaly
anomaly.about: E dey rate how serious di twin state be.

forecasting.name: Forecasting
forecasting.about: E dey run di forecasts wey di twin goals need.

explanation.name: Explanation
explanation.about: E dey explain unmet goals and outputs for watch or alert level.

recommendation.name: Recommendation
recommendation.about: E dey propose support actions wey dey inside di knowledge base, each one with im source.

orchestrator.name: Twin orchestrator
orchestrator.about: E dey sense, update di state, check goals, plan, act, explain and report for one member twin.

conductor.name: Conductor
conductor.about: E dey turn one person care goal to sub-goals, arrange di orchestrators and settle quarrel between dia plans.

history.name: History taking
history.about: E dey list di inputs wey di episode still need.

evidence.name: Evidence assembly
evidence.about: E dey gather readings, medicines, twin states and explanations from di human twin.

differential.name: Differential diagnosis
differential.about: E dey rank di diagnoses and build dia explanation bundles.

investigation.name: Investigation
investigation.about: E dey choose di tests wey go change di diagnosis pass for dia price.

treatment.name: Treatment planning
treatment.about: E dey list di options and simulate di first three for di patient twin.

pharmacotherapy.name: Pharmacotherapy
pharmacotherapy.about: E dey check interactions, kidney function, pregnancy and genome for each dose.

guard.name: Safety and consent guard
guard.about: E dey check every agent action before e run.

system.safety: How di system keep clinicians in charge
system.safetyAbout: Two separate checks dey stop agent from deciding clinical matter.

guard.name: Autonomy levels
guard.about: Each kind of action get one fixed level, from inform reach never. Agent no fit ever sign, order or dispense.

human.name: Person for every decision
human.about: Di API dey accept decision only from person wey get di role wey di step need, never from agent or service.

consent.name: Consent
consent.about: Person fit hold back any kind of data. Every tool call dey check di person consent first.

audit.name: Audit
audit.about: Dem dey write every request, decision and refusal inside one hash-chained audit log.

system.modelsAbout: Every model get one fidelity tier wey show how dem build am.
